secrets.name: CLERK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk Backend API key (dashboard.clerk.com -> API keys, sk_test_...). Clerk is not emulated; without the real key the site renders signed out.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Clerk publishable key, same dashboard page (pk_test_...). Public: it is built into the page.

secrets.name: CLERK_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET
secrets.description: Clerk webhook signing secret (dashboard.clerk.com -> Webhooks, whsec_...). Needed for /api/webhooks/clerk to sync Clerk users into accounts.

secrets.name: OWNER_EMAIL
secrets.description: The email of the one Owner account. The first verified Clerk sign-in with this address seeds the Owner.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. console.anthropic.com -> API keys (sk-ant-...). Without it AI features are off and the rest of the site works.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. resend.com -> API keys (re_...). Without it notices are recorded as skipped.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. dashboards.stripe.com -> Developers -> API keys, test mode (sk_test_...). Missing values switch billing off (503), not the site.

secrets.name: STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.description: Optional. Stripe webhook endpoint's signing secret (whsec_...), test mode.
